test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Why did Vasco da Gama’s crew stay at Rio dos Bons Sinais for a month?

options.text: To erect a statue in the name of Portugal
Several crew members were suffering from scurvy.
There were severe storms in the area.

solution: The correct answer is '**Several crew members were suffering from scurvy**.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The first sentence of the last paragraph says "***They stayed here for a month because much of the crew were sick from scurvy** – a disease caused by lack of Vitamin C*''. (अंतिम पैराग्राफ का पहला वाक्य कहता है, वे यहां एक महीने तक रहे क्योंकि अधिकांश चालक दल स्कर्वी से बीमार थे - विटामिन सी की कमी के कारण होने वाली बीमारी) • From the above sentence, we can say that Vasco da Gama’s crew stayed at Rio dos Bons Sinais for a month because several crew members were suffering from scurvy. (उपरोक्त वाक्य से हम कह सकते हैं कि वास्को डी गामा का दल एक महीने के लिए रियो डॉस बोन्स सिनाईस में रुका था क्योंकि चालक दल के कई सदस्य स्कर्वी से पीड़ित थे) Hence, the only possible answer is option 2. 6f:T119b, The correct answer is '**To feed the stray dogs**.'
